name: ListResourceShares

parameters.help_en:
The owner of the resource shares. Valid values:

*   Self: the current account
*   OtherAccounts: an account other than the current account
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元归属者。取值：

- Self：查询当前账号的共享单元列表。
- OtherAccounts：查询其他账号共享给当前账号的共享单元列表
parameters.name: resource_owner

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource share
parameters.name: resource_share_name

parameters.help_en:
The status of the resource shares. Valid values:

*   Active
*   Pending
*   Deleting
*   Deleted

>  The system automatically deletes the records of resource shares in the Deleted state within 48 hours to 96 hours after you delete the resource shares
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元状态。取值：

- Active：已启用。
- Pending：待确认。
- Deleting：删除中。
- Deleted：已删除。

> Deleted状态的共享单元记录，会在48~96小时内被系统自动删除
parameters.name: resource_share_status

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The `token` that is used to initiate the next request if the response of the current request is truncated. You can use the token to initiate another request and obtain the remaining records
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the resource shares.

Valid values of N: 1 to 5. This indicates that a maximum of five resource shares can be specified at a time
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多指定5个共享单元
parameters.name: resource_share_ids

parameters.help_en: The information about the permissions. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465474.html
parameters.help_zh: 共享权限名称。具体信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465474.html
parameters.name: permission_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
